For 2527 N Burling Ave, Chicago, IL 60614
From RT-4 to an RM-4.5

1.A. The applicant seeks a zoning change from an RT-4 Residential Two-Flat,
Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to that of an RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit
District to meet the bulk and density standards of the RM-4.5 zoning district to
allow the applicants to renovate the property and add a basement unit.
